name: arm circles
source_instructions: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Do 10 to 15 circles, then reverse direction.

phases.label: Three reverse circles, return to small radius

interpretation: Eight-second authored demonstration: three forward circles growing wrist radius 45→140 mm, then three reverse circles returning to 45 mm. Source 10–15 circles before reversing is retained separately; demo cadence/count are not source workout claims. Arms remain near shoulder height, elbows have 12° soft flexion, hands are open/relaxed, shoulders do not shrug and both actual soles remain stationary/supported. Original Shoulder/Arm/Neck/Head weights are exact; only the diagnosed distal plantar recipe is reused. Mirror-time poses are identical while travel direction reverses; assess direction in playback. No measured activation or clinical claim.
